heading.title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

article.title: Rights and liabilities of parties to anomalous mortgages.
article.content: In the case of 3[an anomalous mortgage] the rights and liabilities of the parties shall be determined by their contract as evidenced in the mortgage-deed, and, so far as such contract does not extend, by local usage.
article.html:
98Rights and liabilities of parties to anomalous mortgages.

Section 98 · Chapter IV · Anomalous Mortgages · page 36 of the Act

In the case of 3[an anomalous mortgage] the rights and liabilities of the parties shall be determined by their contract as evidenced in the mortgage-deed, and, so far as such contract does not extend, by local usage.

3 Subs. by Act 20 of 1929, s. 49, for certain words.
